### The Fifth Trumpet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-fifth-trumpet
Passage: Revelation 9:1-12
Points:
- The sounding of the fifth trumpet unleashes terrifying judgment from the Abyss, pictured as a ferocious swarm of locusts.
- This vivid imagery evokes military conflict and demonic oppression, intended to convey the horror of divine wrath upon human sin.
- The tormenting swarm is strictly restrained by God, permitted only to strike the unrepentant and forbidden from harming those sealed by Him.
- God exercises complete sovereignty over evil powers, at times using them to bring justice upon persecutors of His church.
- Believers belong to Christ and possess eternal life, giving them lasting assurance and freedom from fear even amid fearful judgments.
